Chunks of 256 and 512 tokens were compared with 15% overlap. The 256-token chunks achieve better recall for questions seeking a specific date, role, or condition. The 512-token chunks perform better on multi-hop questions that need to combine a general rule with an exception located in the same section.

Hybrid-system results on the development set are recall@10 of 0.81 with 256 and 0.79 with 512; MRR is 0.63 and 0.65 respectively. The 512 configuration creates 38% fewer chunks but increases the average context length sent to the generator and the cost per answer.

A single configuration will not be selected yet. The main baseline will retain 256 tokens because it maximizes coverage. A context-expansion strategy will be evaluated in which the smaller chunk is retrieved and neighboring chunks are added when the question requires context. Tomás will document the exact parameters and repeat the analysis by category.
